messages:
Ruth A: quick convo 1: packaging Datadog + OTEL guidance for the HW marketplace tile. partner asked for an easy install + observability checklist. need final bundle by EOD Thu.
Darren C: list the artifacts so we can scope the PR.
Ruth A: must-haves: minimal OTEL collector config, example span attributes, dashboard JSON, short ops runbook (rotate/retention), privacy note (no PII in spans), and a 2min demo clip.
Maya S: instrumentation ask from partner: include model_name (coarse), batch_size, and quant_mode. but quant_mode could be high-card. proposal: emit quant_mode only when != "fp16" and also add quant_class (low-card: int8/float16/other).
Omar L: good compromise. also recommend adding model_family as resource attr to reduce cardinality on model_name queries.
Darren C: sampling requirement? partner expects low baseline (3-5%), but full capture for errors and traces > 400ms. OTEL tail_sampling handles both. i'll paste a minimal snippet for the docs.
Maya S: dropping the snippet below (minimal & env placeholders):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: error_capture
        type: string_attribute
        string_attribute:
          key: "error"
          values: ["true"]
      - name: slow_capture
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 400
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_DATADOG_KEY}
```
Ruth A: nice. include a short note about local rate limiter to avoid bursts causing disk pressure.
Omar L: ops runbook bullets: rotate otel logs, keep traces 7d, metrics 30d, and when high-card spans appear switch to metric-only rollups for marketplace tiles. include example `logrotate` snippet.
Darren C: marketplace naming convention proposal (different from others): `Marketplace / Observability Integrations / <PartnerName> / ModelMetrics / <model_family> / Latency`. keeps it explicit for integrators.
Maya S: will draft dashboard JSON with widgets: p50, p95, tail_error%, and qps. adding a widget that filters by model_family and quant_class.
Ruth A: for trace-log linking include `dd.trace_id` in structured logs and index model_family but not quant_mode. document cost tradeoffs.
Darren C: lightweight Datadog query examples for the docs:
- latency p95: `avg:trace.inference.latency{model_family:resnet}.rollup(p95)`
- errors: `sum:trace.inference.errors{*}.as_rate()`
Ruth A: partner also wants a one-paragraph privacy blurb for the marketplace page: no request/response payloads, no user identifiers, only aggregated model telemetry and anonymized ids. i'll draft and ping legal.
Omar L: QA plan: dry-run with partner Fri 09:00 PT. can we generate mixed load (varying batch_size and seq_len) to validate tail capture? Darren, you have a small load-gen script, right?
Darren C: yup, repo: https://git.internal/redwood/obs-loadgen, see /bin/mixed_spike.sh. i'll run it in the dry-run.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: 'Marketplace observability dry-run (Datadog+OTEL)' Fri 09:00 PT Attendees: Ruth A, Darren C, Maya S, Omar L.
Maya S: i'll upload dashboard JSON + OTEL snippet to the PR draft tonight.
Ruth A: perfect. after dry-run i'll open the marketplace PR with owners for each artifact and loop in legal for the announcement sentence. thanks team :rocket:
